name: Depths of flowers
source:
Understanding is the highest form of love...

Eli is just a flower seller offering forget-me-nots, helping others in an  ancient forgetting ritual...

One day he pulls out from the flower river a warrior from old times...

From now on both of them need to face a truth they both hide from themselves...

[From [url=https://strawberrynoodles.itch.io/depths-of-flowers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
理解是爱的最高形式…

伊莱只是一个卖勿忘我的花贩，在古老的遗忘仪式中帮助他人……

一日，他从花河中捞出一位旧时武士……

从现在开始，他们都需要面对一个他们都对自己隐瞒的真相……

[来自[url=https://strawberrynoodles.itch.io/depths-of-flowers]Itch.io[/url]]
